data.name: Alice
data.gender_notes: Alice is used as a female name in christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: From the Germanic adal, 'noble', via the French Alis. Its root is Germanic adal. A medieval Christian name; borne by Saint Alice. Alice is a Germanic name meaning “Noble; of noble kind”. Families who choose it generally do so for the quality the name expresses.
data.spiritual_meaning: Alice expresses “Noble; of noble kind”; spiritual readings of the name are interpretive.
data.etymology: From the Germanic adal, 'noble', via the French Alis.
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Alice total 21, reducing to 3. Number 3 is associated with expression, creativity and optimism.
